nom: Vichy Mineral 89 Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum for Stronger Skin

avis.texte: I have been using this product for about 3 years and it has never broke my face out and I have very sensitive skin. Leaves a nice feeling on my face.

I used the entire bottle. It does go a long way, but i didn't notice any improvements to my skin. It wasn't worse, but it isn't better. The consistency is slightly watery, it's not thick or gel-like more like watery lotion. It was easy to apply, has no fragrance, and did not irritate my skin at all. For those reasons and because of the price point, i would buy again if I can't find anything else. It's very difficult to find a fragrance-free product which doesn't irritate my skin. I gave it 3 stars because I don't see any improvements to my skin after using a big bottle.

I got a sample of this through another company and tried it and it blew my mind. so when I saw it was on sale through Ulta I snatched it up!! this not only adds moisture to your skin, but leaves behind a nice dewy glow without feeling greasy or oily. My skin has never looked better and it hasn't caused my very sensitive skin to break out or have any reaction which is also rare! highly recommend!!

Thank you for providing samples. Without them, I would have never discovered this product. I'm currently on my fourth bottle. That's how effective it is. I usually have normal or very dry skin, and there's no middle ground. It's hydrating and doesn't clog my pores, unlike many skincare products. If you're contemplating buying this, RUNNNNNN, don't walk to Ulta. I've never heard of anybody speak about it not on TikTok or any social media platforms. This is an underrated product. I use it with tretanoin, and azelic acid. I apply the vichy89 twice a day.
All I can say is, this is the best Hylaronic Acid o ever tried! This is a staple from now on.

I have tried this due to all of the good reviews I read. This did nothing for me. After applying my skin felt tighter and drier than ever. I had to use another serum to make my skin feel "real" again. I would not recommend this.
I like this, but I wasn't wowed like the other products. It hydrates, but cheaper products accomplish the same goal.

I purshased this serum in September, and have used it everyday up until the beginning of this month. At first, I enjoyed the consistency and the "glass skin" this serum gave me. However, I began to notice my cheeks and eyes began to become red and irritated. I stopped using this serum for about a week, and my eyes and skin got back to normal. Not sure if this is just a me thing, but if you have sensitive skin AND EYES be careful.

I use this as part of my night skincare routine and it has increased the hydration in my skin (living in the dry dry desert) immensely. I'm not overall impressed with the vitamin C combination but this product on its own is lovely.

avis.titre: Smooth, Refreshing, and Full of Hydration
avis.texte: Love this gel-textured serum. I just started using it but this is my fourth Vichy product purchase. Excited to see how it helps my skin.
I feel like it does its job very good, l have very dry skin , with this product and a nice moisturizer my skin feels really hydrerated

I've tried to like this product after trying a few times and I just don't think it's worth the money. It's not a bad Hyaluronic Acid but it's not even close to the best. For the price, you can definitely find better. The product is slightly sticky and most of the stickiness does stay on your hands. After applying, my face does feel slightly less tight/dry but I still need extra moisture. It had a feel almost like a grippy primer.

avis.titre: Love it but peels under my foundation.
avis.texte: I really like the hydration i get with this, I can only use it before bed because it does peel under my makeup. I keep buying it because is one of the best hyaluronic acids that i have tried.

The only thing I have changed in my skincare regimen is using this serum, and my dermatologist actually commented (without knowing this information) that my skin looked really good! That's a win for me! It's also a great price compared to the high end serums.

avis.titre: I use this product several times in my daily routine
avis.texte: This is a nice product to either put on before your tinted moisturizer or mix it with your tinted moisturizer so it goes on smoother. I even use it on my hands when I want a non greasy moisturizer. I like that it is unscented too.

I have very sensitive skin and this product as been a life saver for me. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this product has made a difference in the hydration of my skin. I have been using this product going on about two or three weeks now and I have noticed a difference in my skin. I highly suggest this for those with dry sensitive skin. I use this product after I wash my face and while my face is still damp.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: The product goes on smooth and not sticky. No irritation. I highly recommend.
I had high hopes for this product because of the reviews. Within just a few days my skin started to break out. I havent had a pimple in years and this gave me pimples all over.

I have tried dozens of serums at all different price points and this is by far my favorite. It feels wonderful on my skin and is not sticky. It also absorbs quickly so I can apply make up immediately after. Love this product and will definitely buy again.
I tried different HA serums and I didnt like them. I dont know what's different about this one but it really hydrates my skin. It helped a lot during the dry months.

I have sensitive acne prone skin that gets dry easily and this stuff has been my holy grail my skin looks AMAZING texture is noticeably improved super hydrated and it did not make me breakout at all great product

This serum is wonderful. Absorbs quickly leaving your skin feeling like it had a great drink of water. There is no pilling. So it's safe for wearing under foundation. I use this and the Bobby Brown Face Base in the morning. Makes my makeup look so smooth on my poor old 47 year old skin.

i bought this because i love adding in a hydrating serum but this truly didnt hydrate or anything does it feel nice yeah sure bit it doesnt hydrate at all and its pricey ao id say no go for something cheaper thay actually works

i bought this because i love adding in a hydrating serum but this truly didnt hydrate or anything does it feel nice yeah sure bit it doesnt hydrate at all and its pricey ao id say no go for something cheaper thay actually works

avis.titre: I plan on buying this product again
avis.texte: I haven't used it long enough to see any long term effects, however, it makes my skin feel great after use. I also really like the texture. The last hyaluronic serum I used was thin and didn't absorb well. This product is thicker and soaks in quickly if you want to layer anything on top. However, my skin feels hydrated after where it used to feel dry.
I apply this product AM and PM. My skin feels more moisturized.

I have been using this face serum for almost two years, and I absolutely love it! I have combination skin, and this doesn't make the oily areas oily, but it hydrates the drier areas. It's also perfect under make up. My skin just feels smooth and looks glowy with this serum!
Very hydrating, I use it everyday. Have used up 2 large bottles so far. I apply to damp skin and use a moisturizer before it dries down. Once that sets there is no tacky feeling.

I have very dry skin that needs to be double moisturized. Over the past two months, I have used this with the Cera Ve moisturizer and there is a noticable improvement in the texture and hydration of my skin. I use one pump two times daily and I still have 2/3 the bottle left. I will repurchase!
Everyone raves about this serum. Even derms in social media and I like the texture and it feels nice/mositurizing but it pills like crazy. So just for that, its meh product.
Stuff is so good. The texture is unlike a serum but not a full on gel. It moistures so well to and works great with my normal moisturizer.

I was excited for this because of reviews but it was really sticky and then flash dried and made my skin feel tight and dry the rest of the day. irritated the skin on my cheeks a little. i highly recommend patch testing this product to see how it works for you. i did not like this at all. it felt like I washed my face with soap and then just let the soap dry and went on with my day. I also don't think it helped my skin to look any different. I usually don't write negative reviews but I've been uncomfortable all day and I needed to get it out.
I tried this after reading so many great reviews and it is 100% worth the hype! I'm on my 3rd bottle. Not too thick. Not too thin. Soaks in quickly. No scent. 10/10 recommend!
Love this. Am using as a part of my night time skincare routine. Hydrating but not sticky

avis.titre: A DRINK OF WATER FOR YOUR FACE
avis.texte: If you have dry skin GET THIS NOW. Its lightweight and absorbs right into your skin, just give it a second. RUN DONT WALK TO GO GET THIS.

The is product and I have been in the healthiest relationship since 2019 lol. I have very dry skin even during summer & this product does not fail me any time of the year. It leaves my skin sooo plump, chef's kiss. It is great even under makeup which I love too. There are no cons to this product imo.

I use this in place of a moisturizer at night during the summer. My skin is acne prone with rosacea. I find that most moisturizers clog and irritate my skin. This one has been the best ive used and ive tried many! Love it so much i buy it for friends and family.
The hydration this product provides is impressive. It helped my incredibly dry skin almost instantly. Staple in my skin care routine. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I've been on a rollercoaster with skincare this year
avis.texte: This product is amazing if you have dry sensitive skin! I've tried soooo many products and this one is my favorite for my skincare routine. I wash my face, use snail mucin, use this, and then finish off with vani moisturizer. Works wonders

I have oily skin type but needed a hydrating light serum because I felt like my moisturizer wasn't enough. Loved it at first, my skin looked glowy and plumped with the serum for a couple weeks.Used this for about 2 months before I started noticing clogged pores but didn't realize it was the product. I was getting more whiteheads over time until I realized it was the serum. Bummed that it didn't work for my skin, and not sure what ingredient triggered it since nothing stood out as clogging. Would not recommend for oily skin types.
don't purchase, waste of money. don't see this add on insta and waste ur money
Feels amazing, is very hydrating but doesnt feel greasy, doesnt make me break out!!
Good for dry skin and hydration is on high level, texture help product to have good absorption and it comes without scent and packing is good for traveling as well

This is one of my all time favorite hydrating serums! It absorbs into the skin beautifully without leaving the skin neither dry nor sticky. The texture is perfect for layering with other serums or skincare products!

avis.titre: OMG!  I notice a difference in one night!
avis.texte: I noticed a smoother face the very next morning! I continue to use it every night and it is my new go to serum! I'll try the eye serum next!
This serum is everything!! So lightweight and will keep your skin hydrated all day long! As a dry skin girly I use this daily and it helped so much. The packaging color is cute as well

The Minéral 89 lives up to the praise it receives on social media, delivering exceptional hydration for parched skin. Its seamless application and non-greasy finish add to its allure, establishing it as a must-have for anyone in search of effective and comfortable hydration.

This product visibly plumps and hydrates dull skin. However, it was too thick for me to use under makeup. I also think it's causing breakouts - havent changed anything else in my routine and getting breakouts I've never had before
I bought this on a whim & on sale; it exceeded my expectations!

avis.titre: Leaves my face smooth and hydrated
avis.texte: I recently got into a proper skin care routine and this is my favorite product! I apply vichys mineral 89 after cleansing and it's so smooth and hydrated afterwards!

Love it!!! It is the only serum that I use, even in my under eyes, it hydrates so much, love recommended, love the packaging it feels fancy, such good ingredients for sensitive skin, I need to buy a new one lol :)
I have never put something so hydrating on my face, my aesthetician recommended this to use for my post microneedling treatment and I have been using it ever since as part as my skincare routine.
This is one of the best Hylaronic acids serum I have ever tried! It makes my skin feel so smooth and hydrating! I've tried so many HA serums but I always end up coming back do this one!
Feels great and actually goes into skin, I'll be buying again. Good value. Good to see you don't have to spend a fortune to have a nice product. Ulta has great beauty products!

This is a really great product; I've had one bottle for a year. Although it shouldn't be used constantly or every day, it is a useful part of a skin care regimen. It really appeals to me. gives my skin a slight sheen and a sense of moisture. Simple to use and leaves no sticky behind

avis.titre: Minéral 89 lives up to the hype!
avis.texte: The Minéral 89 lives up to its social media acclaim, proving to be a fantastic hydrator for thirsty skin. Its smooth application and non-sticky finish enhance its appeal, making it a go-to product for those seeking effective, comfortable hydration.

After trying a random product for the first time on my face I was disappointed after my inner eyelid reacted to it. I wanted to cover the fine lines. Since I was confused about so many different face serums that claimed they were the best, I was reluctant to buy one again. However the reviews from other purchasers of this product were outstanding I decided to give a chance to a second face product and told myself, that if it did the same thing the other one did, that I would stick with my soap and water only routine. I received Vichy and after my wake up cleansing routine I took a drop and applied it under my eyes and another drop on my upper lid. I absolutely loved what I saw next. I wear bifocals so anything in my eye area would be accented especially my lower lid area. After applying Vichy I became enamored with the product. My fine lines vanished under the Vichy's light thick cool viscosity. I loved what it did. I lived how it felt, and it was sans fragrance. Just the perfect combination for my over 60 aged skin. I describe it as a hypoallergenic quality product. Not to mention the compliments from other women under 60 afterwards. This is the product for me at this time in my life.
I love how soft my face feels after putting this one. Retains moisturize and I love how clean the ingredients are! My sensitive skin loves this! I recommend it

This Vichy serum is so hydrating! I love that there are only a few ingredients and it is not wildly expensive. Like with any HA serum I make sure my face is either damp from a toner or facial mist before I apply. Have been using for years now!

So so so so good. It's one of the best hyaluronic acid serums that I've tried that doesn't leave a sticky feeling. Really gel like and very runny but super hydrating. Bottle is also so luxurious for the price.

I live in a dry climate, and I naturally have dry skin. So once winter hits, I have dry patches between my chin and mouth and around my nose. This really felt like it soaked in and kept my skin hydrated all day long! It's a staple in my daily.
Saved my skin! My skin is dry and this made such a big difference
Feels great going on but don't see much difference in skin. Sticky when blending.

I absolutely love this serum. It's very hydrating and it absorbs with little effort. It's definitely helped my dry skin through these cold winter months. The packaging is very classy with a glass bottle. I haven't noticed a scent. This has become a staple in my daily skin care routine.
I really like the texture, it feels very smooth on the skin and not sticky. Very hydrating.
Absolutely love how this feels on my skin under my foundation. The glass bottle is beautiful and the scent is not overwhelming. It helps keep my skin hydrated during the cold winter months.

On my second bottle. I use this on days when my skin doesn't need a moisturizer so I use Vichy before sunscreen or in evenings when I don't want to use actives. You should use it on damp skin though for more effectiveness.
Simple. Elegant. Ancient Wonder for modern earthlings! Alone, mixed with Vitamin C, or layered with whatever sunscreen or products you like. My secret. No makeup needed.

This is my second bottle of this. This lightweight serum is amazing. Packed with great nutrients for the skin, very hydrating with the Hyaluronic acid and makes my skin feel refreshed and hydrated. The light formule makes it easy to layer with other products and it doesn't have a fragrance.

avis.titre: Great for brown skin! and dry skin!
avis.texte: This is the best hydrating serum I've had, and my favorite step. I love how it feels, how it's thick but not heavy, and I love applying to my clean face morning and night. It keeps my skin soft and bright! Dewy, with no shine. I absolutely love!

If you need something that is super gentle or comes in a cool bottle, look no further. Yet I've never known Hyaluronic acid to be strong, it's the gentlest acid on the market. I guess some can justify the price by how much product there is and the brand, I got it half off and I still am going to be looking at other brands for similar products.
This is my newest holy grail. Ive tried multiple brands of hyaluronic acid serums and this one takes the cake. I use it daily. My skin is never oily but hydrated.

I recently started using this Serum, can't say 100% if it works well on my skin. I like the texture, scent but absorption isn't that good for my skin. Still will text it more to know if it's my thing or no.

This serum is not sticky, absorbs fast, doesn't peel after it's dry. It gets along with all my other products. I have eczema and this serum makes my lotion work even better! A must have dry skin people

I adore this serum! Its so plumping, hydrating, and very elegant when applied. Its a thicker gel texture that just melts into the skin. However, I do think some of these reviews are forgetting a necessary component of using a hydrating serum like this. USE A MOISTURIZER ON TOP!! Do NOT just apply this on its own. You need a decent occlusive moisturizer on top to keep the hydration in and keep your skin from drying out. Seriously, wearing this alone does not give adequate moisturization. This is meant to help boost the effects of moisturizer if moisturizer alone is not enough to hydrate your skin. If you use it this way, you are way more likely to get good results from using this.

I love Vichy Mineral 89. I have a non-existent skin care routine and this is my go-to. Basically all I use. I love that it's not one of those super thick, almost gelatinous serums that don't absorb. It's very lightweight and absorbs instantly.

Ive used this for almost 5 months now. This is my first step after cleansing and my last step after moisturizing. I really do notice a difference in the softness and texture of my skin. Will continue to purchase.

I love this product. If I could bathe in it I would. It feels so good on the skin & very lightweight. I have noticed a huge difference in my skins hydration when I use this. I also love the pump on it since it keeps me from using too much at once.
I loved this serum! My skin absorbed it very quickly, it didn't leave a residue and made your skin feel soft. It also doesn't have a strong scent which was nice. Would buy again!

I have dry, semi-sensitive skin, and live in a dry climate. Based on the fabulous reviews, i was ecstatic to try this. I replaced my usual hyaluronic serum with this for the past week to give it a fair shot. Now i can confirm there were no immediate nor later benefits from using this serum. In fact, my skin is dryer (i was shocked it could advance in dryness :| ….). If you have dry skin like myself, don't waste your hard earned dollars.

so this is one of those rare products I will never not have until the day I die. I've spent the last fifteen years with facial skin issues. I've been using this about six weeks and I've never felt this confident about my skin since I was in high school. it's like it moisturizes from the inside out. it feels so good on my skin, absorbs fast, super light, SUPER moisturizing. it's my first step out of the shower. and I refuse to ever be without it. it took years off my face, which had damage from sun and smoking. its also seems to be making a difference in my fine lines that recently popped up. my skin looks fresh and plump and hydrated and healthy. I've my whole life struggled to find anything that moisturized without making my oily skin worse, and I finally found it with this. I'd give it a hundred stars if I could. it's worth every penny, and in comparison to other products. it's really affordable. BUY IT IT'S AMAZING

I have used multiple brands of serums that i clude hyaluronic acid in them, including good molecules and the ordinary.. and this personally beats even those for me! Its so lightweight and my skin is always hydrated without the typical oiliness i was so used to getting through the day.
The gel texture and the smell are nice. I like the glass bottle for a sophisticated look. It is a good moisturizer, my skin stays hydrated all day but the only downside is that my skin stays sticky.

My skin looks plump and hydrated with it on and I've been complimented on it too. It's also helped in combatting redness and dehydrated inflammation. My acne does not flare up with this serum on and I don't feel like I need to top it off with a moisturizer to avoid making it greasy (as it's already very hydrating). My skin feels so smooth and soft with this serum on. This product is so much better than my previous hyaluronic acid

avis.titre: Great product and good for oily/acne prone/combination skin
avis.texte: I have been eyeing this lroduct from a long time and get it 50% off in Ulta haul this holiday season. Its a product that didn't break me out. Volcanic water in this product act same as laroch posay volcanic water mist. Been using it with my other skinncare products which include plump plum skin and Vit C glow recipe and Tula It sits great under sunscreen and under makeup.

This is an amazing hydrating serum. You can use it as a serum or alone as a moisturizer. I have very sensitive skin and this is one of the few products I can use without causing my skin to be irritated. It honestly feels like a drink of water for my face. LOVE Vichy.

One pump ladies, one pump goes a long way. I am of the darker persuasion in her late 30s and it is hard to find a good serum that's not trying to bleach or burn my skin. I use it day and night. It goes on smooth and works well with other products.

I feel like Vichy is luxury skincare in drug store price. They have the best hyaluronic acid I've ever tried. A CS representative told me that since it is owned by L'Oréal they are all the same but I don't think so.

avis.titre: BUY IT RIGHT NOW!! No seriously....
avis.texte: Keeps my skin so hydrated!! I would recommend this to anyone.
Helps my skin so much. I've been using it for years and love it

Got this little sample at Walgreens. Great product its lightweight, hydrating and leaves the skin feeling smooth and it makes my face look healthy and glowy. It's fast absorbing. Doesn't have fragrance which is good for sensitive skin.
Absolutely love this product and the sticky/thick formula. Definitely feels hydrating on the skin. Love the luxurious glass packaging as well
I applied it for two consecutive days and feel my skin felt hydrated, illuminated and rest. I'm 59 years old and have used other brands more expensive but this one has the same results or better.

avis.titre: Is good but can mess up makeup base!
avis.texte: So my dermatologist reccomend me this brand because it was super lightweight with a great absorption rate. However it did not sit on my skin right and made my makeup have an bad texture. It doesn't have a scent and is clear which is nice so it's not noticeable!

I think this product is quite good. I have been using it for a short time but I have not seen any negative reaction on my skin. The truth is that it seems a little expensive to me, but to test it I bought the Travel size which would be the travel size and the truth is that I like it. It has gone very well, I am already halfway through it. I really like the texture it leaves on my skin and how it dissolves and how it is absorbed. It is super easy and the truth is that the serum does not have any type of aroma or fragrance, so I I would very much like to recommend them to my friends because the brand, apart from being a very prestigious brand, produces very good quality products.

I've used my internet on and ask for the last 2 years. Island physically touch my face with them and please name it lasting hydration throughout the day. I love it's natural ingredients like the volcanic water. It doesn't claim to do all things for all people but it does put itself forward as an outstanding hydrologic moisturizer....and that it is.
Vichy products are the only ones that do not break out my skin and does what it promises. My skin is soft all day now.
This was my first time trying this product. I really like it because it fast absorbing, non-sticky, and a little goes a long way. It's not too expensive either!

Omg I have this bottle for years and I did not remember how many bottles like this I've used. Talk about my skin, I have a combination skin and I usually feel too much oil in my T area. This one is a game changer especially in the summer. No more oil, no more redness and keeps hydrating all day.

It's a new to me moisturizer. It goes on a littler weird; too little and it feels like it's not enough but too much and it feels like your face is soaking. There's no scent so that's a bonus and it comes in a small box. Not bad but not sure if I'll use again.

Ok...for the price this product is worth it's weight in gold! I read some reviews and decided to try this, even though it was a bit pricier. Let me tell you...I am so glad I did!! My skin feels amazing! It feels and looks more hydrated, yet not sticky! I am in love with this product and will be purchasing the bigger bottle next time!!

avis.titre: Skincare for all with hyaluronic acid
avis.texte: I recommend this Mineral 89 serum by Vichy Laboratories. It's lightweight and effective, and it doesn't irritate my skin. This is skincare for all -- gender-neutral, no scent. Who wants stronger, plumped skin? Everyone! I received it as a sample. I learned on their website to apply this to just-cleansed STILL DAMP skin, because it contains hyaluronic acid. Apparently that's something that some people already know about hyaluronic acid, but it's new knowledge for me.

I USED TO HAVE oily combo skin, but because I started using retinol for my acne scarring and acne in general, my skin dried out ALOT. So I did research and hyaluronic acid helps big time. I already have used some Vichy products in the past and I really liked it but I never tried their serum because of the price. But I caved in because I saw so many good reviews. All I can tell you is that my skin feels 100x better. Like seriously- my skin used to feel tight and look dull but this serum just brings back all that hydration back. (Plus the use of other hydrating products-) but I can definitely tell this serum took my skincare to the next level. It has a mix of a watery- gel consistency and a little goes a long way. I liked to use this serum after toner and after another one of my serums then I put the Vichy serum on top to lock in all that moisture. I did find that it could be difficult for the product to absorb, especially during Spring and Summer.
I apply this serum in the morning and it keeps my skin hydrated. I also use it as a primer before putting my makeup on and it works great. Doesn't have much of a scent and doesn't irritate my skin.

This is probably the best HA I have ever used. Within just a few days I noticed drastic changes in my skin. Im a skincare junkie if you will. I have tried many forms of sodium hylauronate and I don't know if I can compare a single one of them.
Evert since I've started using this product I've noticed a drastic change in the feeland appearance of my skin. My skin looks firm, healthy, well hydrated and absolutely beautiful.
On my 2nd bottle and don't plan on stopping!! This gel serum is amazing and my skin loves it. Super moisturizing, gives that glass skin look and feel!
I read reviews here on influenster and decided to order a bottle. I am not disappointed! Only been using for about a month and can tell a small difference in the firmness in my skin.

I like this product and purchased it in Europe because I was influenced by Tik Tok… needless to say it feels nice on this skin but I can't tell any solid difference in my complexion yet. I've been using it for about a month.
I use this before active ingredients that might irritate (like vitamin c or tretinoin) or after peptides or ceramides to add some hydration. It works well with other serums and under make-up

I buy other hyaluronic acids (the ordinary) but I will always keep this in my skincare collection I don't know if it the bottle or what but it makes me feel amazing using it and just enjoy the packaging alot!
I use this product all the time and it makes my skin feel absolutely amazing. I have combination skin and this worked so well for me.
Such a nice and soft feeling serum. Two pumps covers the whole face and neck. It glides onto my skin perfectly. Isn't oily at all and it's perfect on my sensitive skin! Love this product so much.

I use this in the morning prior to sunscreen and again at night after using my Retin A and it stops me from any irritation. I've been using it x 1 month and love it. Even my husband uses it twice daily now.
I used this product everyday for 30 days and I saw a noticeable difference in my skins hydration. When I ran out I waited two weeks before getting it again and I saw the difference it made.
